title: BAGEL: Adversarially Constrained Online Convex Optimization under Separation Oracle Access
abstract: arXiv:2502.16744v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In adversarial Constrained Online Convex Optimization (COCO), a learner selects actions from a fixed convex set while seeking both low regret and low cumulative constraint violation (CCV) under time-varying constraints. We ask what performance is achievable when the action set is accessed through a Separation Oracle (SO), rather than an exact Projection Oracle (PO) or a Linear Optimization Oracle (LOO). We introduce $\mathtt{BAGEL}$, which combines a Lyapunov-weighted surrogate loss, blocked adaptive online gradient descent, and an infeasible-projection procedure implemented with an SO. translated_title: BAGEL：在分离预言机访问下的对抗性约束在线凸优化
translated_abstract: 在对抗性约束在线凸优化（COCO）中，学习者在固定凸集中选择动作，同时需要在时变约束下追求低遗憾和低累积约束违反（CCV）。我们研究了当动作集通过分离预言机（SO）而非精确投影预言机（PO）或线性优化预言机（LOO）访问时，所能达到的性能。我们引入了$\mathtt{BAGEL}$，它结合了李雅普诺夫加权替代损失、分块自适应在线梯度下降以及使用SO实现的不可行投影过程。对于凸成本且任意$\beta\in(0,1/2]$，$\mathtt{BAGEL}$实现了$\mathcal{O}(T^{1-\beta})$的遗憾和$\mathcal{O}(T^{1-\beta}\log T)$的累积违反，同时使用$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}((D/r)^2T^{2\beta})$次SO调用。在$\beta=1/2$时，这给出了$\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$的遗憾和$\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T}\log T)$的违反，且调用次数接近线性。
tldr: 本文提出了BAGEL算法，在仅使用分离预言机的情况下，实现了对抗性约束在线凸优化中接近最优的遗憾和违反界限，同时保持近乎线性的预言机调用次数。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BAGEL, an algorithm that achieves near-optimal regret and violation bounds in adversarial constrained online convex optimization using only a separation oracle, with nearly linear oracle call complexity.
